unrediscovered.title: The 2,500-year-old toxic-manager taxonomy
unrediscovered.note: Four bad things: putting people to death without instructing them (cruelty); demanding the full tale of work suddenly without warning (oppression); issuing lax orders then insisting with severity (injury); stingy rewards (acting the part of a mere official).

unrediscovered.title: Wind and grass: the mechanism of culture
unrediscovered.note: Let your evinced desires be for what is good, and the people will be good. Superiors and inferiors are like wind and grass -- the grass bends where the wind blows. Culture follows what the leader visibly wants, not what the handbook says.

unrediscovered.title: Adversarial calibration
unrediscovered.note: Do not trust universal approval or universal hatred. The read that matters: the good in the neighborhood love him, and the bad hate him. Approval from the wrong people is a contra-indicator.

unrediscovered.title: Salary-shame as a selection filter
unrediscovered.note: When good government prevails, to be thinking only of salary is shameful. Intrinsic motivation used not as engagement fluff but as a criterion for who should hold office.

unrediscovered.title: Retention through contented repose
unrediscovered.note: Rulers are not troubled lest their people be few, but lest they not keep their several places. Attract the remote with civil culture and virtue, and make them contented and tranquil. Retention as an outcome of fit and ease, not perks.
